title: Crucial Structural Understanding for Selective HDAC8 Inhibition: Common Pharmacophores, Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics, and Zinc Binder Analysis of Selective HDAC8 Inhibitors.
authors: Sarkar, Kakali; Debnath, Sudhan; Sen, Debanjan; Kar, Supratik; Sil, Samir Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HDAC8抑制剂的结构药理学，涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Overexpression of HDAC8 was observed in various cancers and inhibition of HDAC8 has emerged as a promising therapeutic approach in recent decades. OBJECTIVE: This review aims to facilitate the discovery of novel selective HDAC8 inhibitors by analyzing the structural scaffolds of 66 known selective HDAC8 inhibitors, along with their IC50 values against HDAC8 and other HDACs. METHODS: The inhibitors were clustered based on structural symmetry, and common pharmacophores for each cluster were identified using Phase. Molecular docking with all HDACs was performed to determine binding affinity and crucial interacting residues for HDAC8 inhibition. Representative inhibitors from each cluster were subjected to molecular dynamics simulation to analyze RMSD, RMSF, active site amino acid residues, and crucial interacting residues responsible for HDAC8 inhibition. The study reviewed the active site amino acid information, active site cavities of all HDACs, and the basic structure of Zn(2+) binding groups. RESULTS: Common pharmacophores identified included AADHR_1, AADDR_1, ADDR_1, ADHHR_1, and AADRR_1. Molecular docking analysis revealed crucial interacting residues: HIS- 142, GLY-151, HIS-143, PHE-152, PHE-208 in the main pocket, and ARG-37, TYR-100, TYR- 111, TYR-306 in the secondary pocket. The RMSD of protein and RMSF of active site amino acid residues for stable protein-ligand complexes were less than 2.4 A and 1.0 A, respectively, as identified from MD trajectories. The range of Molecular Mechanics Generalized Born Surface Area (MM-GBSA) DeltaG predicted from MD trajectories was between -15.8379 A and -61.5017 A kcal/mol. CONCLUSION: These findings may expedite the rapid discovery of selective HDAC8 inhibitors subject to experimental evaluation.
abstract_zh: 背景：HDAC8的过表达已在多种癌症中观察到，抑制HDAC8在近几十年中已成为一种有前景的治疗方法。目的：本综述旨在通过分析66种已知选择性HDAC8抑制剂的结构骨架及其对HDAC8和其他HDAC的IC50值，促进新型选择性HDAC8抑制剂的发现。方法：基于结构对称性对抑制剂进行聚类，并使用Phase识别每个聚类的共同药效团。对所有HDAC进行分子对接，以确定结合亲和力及对HDAC8抑制至关重要的相互作用残基。对每个聚类的代表性抑制剂进行分子动力学模拟，分析RMSD、RMSF、活性位点氨基酸残基以及负责HDAC8抑制的关键相互作用残基。研究回顾了活性位点氨基酸信息、所有HDAC的活性位点空腔以及Zn(2+)结合基团的基本结构。结果：识别的共同药效团包括AADHR_1、AADDR_1、ADDR_1、ADHHR_1和AADRR_1。分子对接分析揭示了关键相互作用残基：主口袋中的HIS-142、GLY-151、HIS-143、PHE-152、PHE-208，以及次级口袋中的ARG-37、TYR-100、TYR-111、TYR-306。从MD轨迹中识别出，稳定蛋白-配体复合物的蛋白RMSD和活性位点氨基酸残基RMSF分别小于2.4 Å和1.0 Å。从MD轨迹预测的分子力学广义Born表面积（MM-GBSA）DeltaG范围在-15.8379至-61.5017 kcal/mol之间。结论：这些发现可能加速选择性HDAC8抑制剂的快速发现，并需经实验评估验证。
